Asset.description: A unit of legal property that can be held in a portfolio.

AssetIdentifier.description: An external identifier scheme value for an asset.

Event.description: An immutable record of a state change to a position.

FactField.description: One typed field of a fact type value.

FactType.description: One fact type in the machine-readable catalog.

FactType.is_active.description: Whether the subject is currently active.

FactType.last_verified_at.description: When the asset's reference data was last verified.

FactType.market_price.description: End-of-day OHLCV bar for an asset.

FactType.name.description: A source-reported name for an asset, issuer, or portfolio.

FactType.nav.description: A fund's net asset value per unit.

FactType.rank.description: A source-assigned integer rank for an asset.

close.description: Unadjusted closing price for the observation window.

high.description: Highest traded price for the observation window.

low.description: Lowest traded price for the observation window.

open.description: Opening price for the observation window.

volume.description: Traded volume in shares or contracts.

Issuer.description: The legal entity that issues or guarantees assets.

IssuerIdentifier.description: An external identifier scheme value for an issuer.

MarketObservation.description: A typed market price, bar, or quote observation.

Portfolio.description: A node in the portfolio DAG that groups positions and rules.

Position.description: The quantity of one asset held by one portfolio at an instant.

Rule.description: A named rule expression attached to a portfolio.

TemporalFact.description: An append-only bitemporal belief about a subject.

x-obolargus-invariants: Portfolio graph is a DAG.
An asset may not be backed by a portfolio that contains itself.
Any level may carry accounting.
Positions are derived from events.
Events are immutable.
Every fact and observation is dual-temporal and append-only.
Conflict resolution is by known_at.
Per-field aggregates are declared, not inferred.
`last` is time-coordinated.
Numeric-only constraint: no sum/avg on non-numeric fields.
Identity fields are none.
Issuer graph is a DAG.
An external identifier names at most one subject within its domain.
Rule names are unique across the rule catalog.
Rules are not inherited from ancestor portfolios.
A portfolio carries a given rule at most once.
A fact has exactly one subject reference.
Every fact value is typed by the catalog.
Market prices are observations, not reference facts.
No canonical fact value is stored as text or JSON.
